old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-25hs","title":"Packet-format oracle helpers accept non-canonical scalar types","description":"The modified public helpers in python/src/lichen/packets/formats.py do not enforce their annotated protocol scalar types: link_frame_overhead(signed='false') treats the non-empty string as signed, total_packet_size_range(routing_overhead=3.5) returns float byte counts and accepts bool, and dio_packet_bytes accepts bool for one-byte/u16 fields because bool subclasses int. These helpers feed canonical size/vector oracles, so malformed test inputs can silently produce plausible but non-canonical expected values. Require exact bool for signed and exact integers for byte-count/DIO numeric fields, retaining current range checks, with bool/float/string/None regression tests.","status":"open","priority":4,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T14:16:00.108957Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T14:16:00.108957Z"}
